frameInspection.normalNavigation: Extracted frames show an overlap/fade during transition and settled Activity/Settings states. This demonstrates animated transition content, not a frame-accurate Tomato timing match.
frameInspection.reducedMotion: Animator-zero video contains fewer frames than normal video and reaches verified destination states. It does not establish a full accessibility or animation smoothness result.
frameInspection.largeFont: Reviewed stop and scan captures show full action labels. Status wraps/reflows beside the control; this does not prove every narrow device or dynamic discovery string.

qualitativeReferenceComparison.reference: Official Tomato v2.0.1 evidence in .a5c/artifacts/iteration3-reference-ui.json, captured on same emulator before Plink capture.
matchesObserved: Dedicated large top-bar title and subtitle are present in Plink captures.
Floating blue navigation shares the expressive selected-pill presentation.
Normal navigation capture visibly overlaps/fades while transitions settle.
gapsObserved: Same dark-mode Settings captures show Tomato Settings with a lighter gray overall background than Plink Settings/Connection black background. This is a visible surface-color mismatch, qualified because the apps use different Settings content and surface layouts.
Plink Settings uses large colored feature cards and Tomato Settings reference uses a different timer/settings composition; no complete visual-equivalence conclusion follows.
No frame-quantized timing tolerance or pixel-level comparison was performed.
